international.title: Russia, Saudi Arabia and Australia named as biggest CO2 exporters in history
international.summary: Analysis of fossil fuel exports since 1850 differs from most assessments – which look at countries where CO 2 is released Russia, Saudi Arabia and Australia are the three biggest exporters of carbon dioxide in history, according to analysis of fossil fuels since 1850. Russia tops the list of global exporters of fossil fuels, with its vast coal, oil and gas deposits. Accounting for the CO 2 produced by burning these exports, Russia has been responsible for more than 70 gigatonnes, up to the end of 2025. Continue reading...
